label: Euthyphro modal approval test has joint and omission models
meaning: On the existing knife and counterweight profile: a divine joint model has goodness as due actuality in every profile, supervenience, approval exactly of the good, approvals fixed by natures and no variation; there the extensional approval-failure premise is false while the weak approval premise and the due thesis hold. A human-assessor model satisfies invariance, variation and transfer, and the approval account fails. A rigidified model omits transfer: invariance and variation hold, approval does not ground, yet base approval is correct. A voluntarist model omits invariance: approval varies and grounds goodness. A modified command model keeps goodness fixed and approval grounding while commands and obligations vary. General conjuncts: robust due actuality gives supervenience; weak invariance equals stable truth of every aspect over the nature-fixed profiles; the rigidified account excludes transfer; command-constituted obligation with command variation is not invariant.
